query:
SELECT * FROM (
      SELECT 
        b.id, b.name, b.slug, b.city, b.region, b.hub, b.logoUrl, b.description,
        b.googleRating, b.googleReviewCount, b.approvalStatus, b.claimedByUserId,
        bt.name as businessTypeName, bt.id as businessTypeId,
        (
          CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM businessSportCategories bsc 
            WHERE bsc.businessId = b.id AND bsc.sportCategoryId IN (1,2)
          ) THEN 30 ELSE 0 END
          +
          CASE WHEN b.businessTypeId IN (1,13) THEN 25 ELSE 0 END
          +
          CASE WHEN LOWER(b.city) = LOWER('Boulder') AND 'Boulder' != '' THEN 20 ELSE 0 END
        ) as matchScore,
        'test' as matchReason
      FROM businesses b
      LEFT JOIN businessTypes bt ON b.businessTypeId = bt.id
      WHERE b.isActive = 1 AND b.isAdminHidden = 0 AND b.approvalStatus = 'approved'
    ) AS scored
    WHERE matchScore > 0
    ORDER BY matchScore DESC, googleReviewCount DESC
    LIMIT 12

rows.name: APEX Coaching
rows.description: APEX Coaching provides high-performance coaching to endurance athletes of all levels, specializing in one-on-one coaching for triathletes and cyclists.

rows.name: Colby Pearce
rows.description: Colby Pearce is a former professional cyclist, 2004 Olympian, and 14-time National Track Champion. He is a USAC Level One coach and offers coaching services through Team EF Coaching.

rows.name: Paragon Fit Studio
rows.description: Paragon Fit Studio offers professional, hands-on bike fitting services for cyclists of all levels in the San Francisco Bay Area.

rows.name: Capra Running
rows.description: Capra Running is a specialty trail running store in Squamish that sells shoes, apparel, and accessories for trail runners and hikers.

rows.name: Personal Peak Coaching
rows.description: Travis Brown is the Head Physiologist at Personal Peak. With a Masters of Kinesiology and certification as an Exercise Physiologist, he specializes in breaking down sports and optimizing training for runners, cyclists, and multi-sport athletes of all levels.

rows.name: Pinnacle Running
rows.description: Pinnacle Running offers coaching and training for runners of all ages and abilities in the Marin area, including a summer trail running series to prepare for local races.

rows.name: Boston Run Coaching
rows.description: Boston Run Coaching offers personalized running plans, one-on-one coaching, and in-person sessions for runners of all levels, from 800m to the marathon distance.

rows.name: Anna Frost Coaching
rows.description: Anna Frost Coaching offers personalized running coaching to help runners of all levels achieve their goals. They provide customized weekly training programs, goal setting advice, and race planning from one of the world's most accomplished ultra-trail runners.

rows.name: Chamonix Mountain Endurance Academy
rows.description: The Chamonix Mountain Endurance Academy offers programs to optimize fitness, athletic potential, and mountain skills through training camps, clinics, and masterclasses.

rows.name: Durango Performance Center
rows.description: Durango Performance Center is a nationally recognized center for athletic development, sports cardiology and medicine, and high altitude physiology research.

rows.name: SWAP Running
rows.description: SWAP Running provides personalized and interactive coaching for runners of all levels, focusing on long-term growth and applying science, research, and training theory.

rows.name: CNEA Font Romeu
rows.description: Font-Romeu's National Altitude Training Center (CNEA) offers optimal conditions for high-performance athletes to train, eat, and rest in a mountainous environment.
